typ_public_edge_vanPlaza: RULE: City of Vancouver Zoning and Development By-law No. 3575, Section 2, June 2026, p. 31: 'Plaza: An open space for use by the public, generally provided with amenities such as seating, drinking and ornamental fountains, weather-proofing, art, trees, and landscaping ... publicly owned, or privately owned with a secured right-of-access for the public'; I-3 s. 2.1 lists Park or Playground (C) and Parking Uses (C) but not Plaza (text search) — sources/library/public/van3575s2/full.pdf; data/raw/van/i3.txt
typ_public_edge_edmUses: RULE: City of Edmonton Zoning Bylaw 20001 (as adopted; local text) 8.10: Park 'land is publicly accessible and used for active or passive recreation', examples incl. 'plazas'; Parking Facility 'vehicle parking is located on a Site that has any principal Use other than Standalone Parking Facilities'; Vehicle Support Service 'vehicle servicing operations for the repair, maintenance, or fuelling of automobiles' (<4,600 kg GVWR), examples 'fuel stations, car washes'; BE s. 2 and IM s. 2 list neither Park nor Parking Facility; Vehicle Support Service P (BE 2.17, IM 2.10), to comply with 6.110 (not read); Special Event P (BE 2.20, IM 2.11) — data/raw/edm/bylaw/b.txt
